name: Update Project
query: Update my Physical AI Research project. Change the description to 'Research on physical AI, robotics, humanoids, and intelligent machines' and set the location to Lucknow.
context: The authenticated user has access to a project named 'Physical AI Research'. The exact project_id is not provided. The project contains existing values for its name, status, visibility, notebook count, members, and other project metadata. The user only wants to change the description and location.
expected_behavior: Recognizes that the request is an update to an existing project
Uses get_projects to identify the correct project when project_id is unknown
Does not modify the project name because the user did not request it
Does not modify status, visibility, enabled state, membership, billing, API keys, or other administrative fields
success_criteria: The correct Physical AI Research project is identified
update_project is used with the actual project_id
The description is updated to the requested value
The location is updated to Lucknow
The model does not invent unsupported update parameters
The model does not provide user_id
The final response accurately reports the successful update

additional_scenario.query: Rename my Physical AI Research project to Lucknow Physical AI Research
additional_scenario.context: The project_id is already available from the preceding conversation.
expected_behavior: Uses update_project directly without unnecessary project discovery
Supplies project_name with the requested new name
Does not change the description or other fields
success_criteria: Only the project name is changed
No unrelated project fields are modified
